$comment: boxPx, baselinePx, deltaE2000, ssimNonText and ssimElement are calibrated in M0 (docs/findings/m0.md §11). The text ink keys come from the fidelity suite's measurement of every kit text style, light on dark and dark on light, at 2560, 1920 and 1280, with the designs rendering -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased (docs/findings/text-ink.md): ink colour ΔE2000 at most 1.26 from 9 device px up, 2.12 at 8 px, 8.23 at 6 px; Unity's ink amount 0.92-1.08 of the design's, within -5 % … +11.7 % of the capture's median per polarity. Limits = measured plus a margin: textInkDeltaE from textInkFullPx device px, below it the first [px, limit] pair of textInkDeltaESmall the text reaches; a line's ink amount between textInkRatio x (1 - textInkCoverage) and 1 + textInkCoverage, and within textInkMedianTolerance of the median of the capture's text of the same polarity when there are 3 or more such lines
